text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, my weight had been steadily 
increasing.
choice_data_list: (I know what's causing it—)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
I made a whooole bunch of lunch for 
today too!
choice_data_list: (I know what the cause is—)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I made burgers, tenshinhan, and even 
onigiri! Guess what's inside the rice 
balls? Fried chicken! Hehe, they're super 
yummy, you know?
choice_data_list: T-Thanks as always!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm only cooking because I 
wanted to make food myself!
choice_data_list: Th-Thanks as always!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Special Week has been making lunch for
me 
lately... but the portions are enormous."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so delicious that she ate every
bit 
of it every day,
and ended up gaining fat. 
And so—!
choice_data_list: I'm going on a diet starting today!!
I'm going on a diet starting today!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Even though you're already plenty 
slim!?
choice_data_list: Starting today, I'm going on a diet!!
Starting today, I'm going on a diet!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
It's because of my cooking that 
Trainer is...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! If that's the case... please 
let me help with your diet too!
choice_data_list: Then, could you act as my trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Understood!
I'll play the role of the 
Trainer...!!
choice_data_list: Then could you play the role of th...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Come on! One more uphill sprint! You're 
not allowed to slacken your pace halfway 
through, okay?
choice_data_list: Y-Yes! Spe-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe. So this is what it feels like 
to coach your own trainee!"
choice_data_list: Y-Yes! Spe's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Trainer. Today's efforts 
will make you stronger tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then next up is... wait, Trainer?
choice_data_list: *wheeze* *gasp*... J-Just one more...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You're gasping for breath! I-I'm 
sorry! I didn't know how to pace myself!
choice_data_list: *wheeze, gasp*... J-Just one more ...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...A-All right! Let's wrap it up here for 
today! Here, have some water!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's kindness touches my heart. 
However, it was a misguided consideration.
choice_data_list: If you're going to be a trainer, y...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh... Strictly, you say?
choice_data_list: If you're a Trainer, you need to b...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just being kind all the time doesn't make 
a good trainer. Being strict when the 
situation calls for it is how a trainer 
ought to be.
choice_data_list: If you truly care about me, please...
If you truly care about me, that's...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Understood. In that case, Trainer, 
you—
choice_data_list: If you truly care about me, do that.
If you truly care about me, that's...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, drinking water is 
forbidden for a whole week!!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too harsh!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Aaaah～～ I don't know the right 
balance～～～!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too harsh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. As I waited for Special 
Week's Trainer in the gym—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello,
Trainer-san! Let's do our best with 
the diet today too!
choice_data_list: I look forward to your guidance to...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...About that, though. It really seems 
like I'm not cut out to be a trainer for 
you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: I look forward to your guidance ag...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so—here you go! I made a boxed lunch 
for you!
choice_data_list: O-Ohh, thank you...
Y-Yeah, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't need to be on guard,
you know? 
This one is totally different from the 
ones before!
choice_data_list: O-Oh, thank you...
Y-Yeah, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please take a look at what's inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Urged on, I open the bento—inside, it is 
packed with low-calorie dishes centered 
around broccoli and boiled chicken.
choice_data_list: That looks delicious... Can I try ...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!
choice_data_list: Looks delicious... Mind if I try some?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try a bite of the chicken and kimchi 
stamina stir-fry. —Delicious! It had a 
powerful, flavorful punch that made it 
hard to believe it was diet food.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, this morning—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I went and asked some people who are
good 
at self-management... and got their 
recommendations for the best diet menus!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then everyone was so supportive! It's 
low-calorie, packed with protein, and 
turned into such a delicious bento!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's this,
maybe even I... could be 
of a little help, I thought."
choice_data_list: Thank you... It's truly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just delicious. It was a boxed 
lunch filled with her thoughtful care.
choice_data_list: Thank you... It's really delicious!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Hearing you say that makes me 
happy! Please eat this and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh--!! We did it! The diet was a 
resounding success--!!
choice_data_list: We did it! It's all thanks to your...
We did it! It's all thanks to your...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, it's because you worked so hard, 
Trainer! You did great!
choice_data_list: We did it! It's all thanks to your...
We did it! It's all thanks to your...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know!
To celebrate your successful diet, 
I'll make whatever you want! What would 
you like to eat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked that, I thought for a moment—but 
told her that just as before, I wanted a 
low-calorie lunch box.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
again? Even though you're on a diet, 
you ate so much... Are you sure about 
this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded at her words. Lately,
eating that 
bento has become the highlight of my day, 
and above all—
choice_data_list: As I kept eating it, I totally fel...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, got it! I'll do my best making 
them tomorrow too, then!"
choice_data_list: The more I ate it, the more I fell...
